scenario_steps.name: a copy of `fixtures/cad/ellipse/rotated-measured.opd` is open with Sketch1 being edited in RIGHT view
the user enables Display Curvature, records both slider positions, previews an upper-slider change and cancels it
the ellipse has curvature display enabled
the prior upper-slider preview was cancelled
its original upper and lower thumb positions were recorded
the upper and lower thumbs have their earlier restored positions
the user advance only the lower slider
the comb envelope expands without a visible ellipse shape change
the upper slider stays at its earlier position
the earlier comb envelope returns with curvature still enabled
